tips.text: Buy the key the week it shows up in Nora's rotation; the Oubliette is easy to find and the key is what rotates.
Retry the fight as often as you like; losing does not consume the key, only a win does.
If a crystal renders blank, pick by colour instead; the correct one is clearer or whiter and the wrong ones reflect blue and red.
Bring Sprint Speed mods, Rolling Guard and a slow fall such as Zephyr's passive to reach far platforms and survive one hit.
Do the fight before MR 13 if you like; the blueprint waits in your inventory until you can build it.
Pause with Esc if you need a break mid-fight.
Players call the fight a one-and-done chore: frustrating the first time, a few minutes once you know the crystal tell.
